[[File:Calista AG076.png|thumb|250px|Calista]] '''Calista''' (Japanese: '''クルヨ''' ''Kuruyo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG076|Me, Myself and Time]]''. She also appeared in [[Ash & Pikachu]]. ==In animation== [[File:Calista future AG076.png|thumb|left|220px|Future Calista]] Calista appeared to be very enthusiastic about archaeology and Pokémon. However, her parents refused to support her decision to pursue this career. One day, she received a phone call telling her to go and locate a "Baltoy's path", following the lyrics of a song, on [[Kirikiri Mountain]] with her {{p|Baltoy}}. With {{Ash}}'s help, they located a mysterious woman in the tree hollow, and she guided them through to the Baltoy civilization ruins. The woman pointed to a magic wheel, adding that her Baltoy was trapped under a large number of boulders. Calista used her Baltoy to free the mysterious woman's Pokémon. Following orders, Calista then used her Baltoy's {{m|Rapid Spin}} to reveal the magic wheel's [[time travel]] abilities. The mysterious woman finally revealed her own identity as Calista, but from the future. She encouraged her past self to pursue her ambitions before returning to her own time. {{-}} ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Calista |pkmn=Baltoy |type1=Ground |type2=Psychic |img=Calista Baltoy.png |epnum=AG076 |epname=Me, Myself and Time |vajp=Risa Hayamizu |desc={{p|Baltoy}} was first seen spinning around and heading towards a cliff, though [[Ash's Pikachu]] used {{m|Quick Attack}} to stop it. Later, it helped future Calista's Baltoy, in other words itself, by removing the rocks that were crushing it. Baltoy later used Rapid Spin on the magic wheel, allowing future Calista to return to her own time. Baltoy's known moves are {{m|Rapid Spin}} and {{m|Confusion}}.}} ====In the future==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Calista |pkmn=Xatu |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=Calista Xatu AG076.png |epnum=AG076 |epname=Me, Myself and Time |desc={{p|Xatu}} is a Pokémon owned by future Calista. She first used it to battle {{TRT}}, sending them blasting off with a Shadow Ball. Later, she used it to protect {{Ash}} and present Calista as {{p|Baltoy}} dealt with the fallen rocks hiding the magic wheel and rescued future Calista's Baltoy. Xatu also tried to battle with one of [[Team Rocket's mechas]], but was unable to defeat it. After Baltoy damaged the drill machine, Xatu sent the trio blasting off with another Shadow Ball. Xatu's known moves are {{m|Reflect}}, {{m|Teleport}}, {{m|Peck}}, and {{m|Shadow Ball}}.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{flying color light}} |ja=三石琴乃 ''[[Kotono Mitsuishi]]'' |en=[[Lisa Adams]] (young)

Yolanda Pérez Segoviano (adult)}} ==In the manga== [[File:Calista AP.png|thumb|200px|Calista in Ash & Pikachu]] [[File:Calista 2 AP.png|thumb|left|200px|Future Calista]] ===Ash & Pikachu=== Calista appeared in ''[[SP26|Hunt For The Treasure Of The Universe!]]''. {{Ash}} met her when her {{p|Baltoy}} was spinning around. She showed him a magazine and told him about his dream of becoming an archeologist but her parents refused to support the decision. The lady that Ash saw by the tree before takes him and Calista to the tree hole which led them underground. Using Baltoy, it lifted a pile of boulders out of the way and uncovered a drawing of a Baltoy. After a battle with {{TRT}}, the lady revealed herself to be Calista's future self and stood on the painting as it took her back to her own time. Calista and Ash left the tree and waved their farewells as Ash reunited with {{ashfr}}. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Baltoy 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Calista |pkmn=Baltoy |type1=Ground |type2=Psychic |img=Calista Baltoy AP.png |epnum=SP26 |epname=Hunt For The Treasure Of The Universe! |desc={{p|Baltoy}} is Calista's only known Pokémon. While underground, it lifted up a pile of boulders and battled {{TRT}}.
